exposure: moderate satisfaction with spouse's emotional/financial support
Interval between hospital admission and birth
Mode of delivery (elective caesarean, emergency caesarean, vaginal birth)
long interval between admission to hospital and giving birth
finding: Primiparity, lower maternal well-being, lower satisfaction with pregnancy and spousal support, emergency caesarean section, severe fear of childbirth, and a longer interval between hospital admission and birth were associated with lower birth satisfaction.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was associated with lower birth satisfaction.
